name: Emir of Kuwait
description: Head of state of the State of Kuwait, a constitutional emirate; current emir is Sheikh Mishal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah (since December 2023).

name: Amiri Diwan of Kuwait
description: The Ruler's Court of the State of Kuwait; official office of the Emir.

name: Cabinet of Kuwait
description: Chief executive body of the State of Kuwait; the 46th cabinet was appointed on 12 May 2024, headed by Prime Minister Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah.

name: National Assembly of Kuwait
description: Unicameral legislature of Kuwait with 50 elected members; suspended in 2024 amid political deadlock. Political parties are not legalized; members run as independents.

name: Ministry of Interior (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for internal security, police and residency affairs.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for foreign relations; publishes the official directory of ministries and state institutions.

name: Ministry of Defense (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for defense and the Kuwait Armed Forces.

name: Ministry of Justice (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for the administration of justice and the court system.

name: Ministry of Finance (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for public finance and the state budget.

name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for commerce, industry and company licensing.

name: Ministry of Oil (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for petroleum policy; the Oil Minister in the 2024 cabinet is Dr. Imad Mohammad Al-Atiqi.

name: Ministry of Information (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for media and state broadcasting; Minister of Information in the 2024 cabinet is Abdulrahman Bdah Al-Mutairi.

name: Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for electricity, water and renewable energy utilities.

name: Ministry of Social Affairs (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry of Kuwait responsible for social affairs, labor and civil society licensing.

name: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs (Kuwait)
description: Cabinet department which spreads Islamic culture; responsible for religious endowments (awqaf) and Islamic affairs; also operates as a publisher.

name: Ministry of Health (Kuwait)
description: Government organization in Kuwait City responsible for public health and hospitals.

name: Ministry of Education (Kuwait)
description: Government ministry in Kuwait responsible for public education.

name: Constitutional Court of Kuwait
description: Kuwait's constitutional court, which rules on the constitutionality of laws and decrees; part of Kuwait's court hierarchy described by Kuwaiti legal sources.

name: Court of Cassation (Kuwait)
description: Kuwait's highest appellate court, top level of the Kuwaiti judicial jurisdiction per Kuwaiti legal guides.

name: Kuwait Municipality
description: Municipal authority of Kuwait responsible for urban planning and municipal services; listed in the State of Kuwait official directory.

name: State Audit Bureau (Kuwait)
description: Kuwait's supreme audit institution, an independent state body overseeing public funds; listed in the State of Kuwait official directory.

name: Kuwait Investment Authority
description: Sovereign wealth fund of Kuwait, founded 1953; manages the General Reserve Fund and Future Generations Fund; also owner of Kuwait Airways after the 2026 decree.

name: Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development
description: Governmental development-aid agency of Kuwait founded 1961, providing loans for Arab and developing countries; the first development aid institution in the world outside OECD/DAC frame.

name: Environment Public Authority (Kuwait)
description: Kuwait's environmental regulator.

name: Public Authority for Industry (Kuwait)
description: Government organization in Safat, Kuwait responsible for industrial regulation and standards.

name: Civil Service Council (Kuwait)
description: Established 1 July 1979 under Decree Law No. 15 of 1979; sets civil service policy and modernizes public administration in Kuwait.

name: Insurance Regulatory Unit (Kuwait)
description: Government agency of Kuwait established September 2019 to regulate the insurance sector.

name: Kuwait Ports Authority
description: State authority managing Kuwait's seaports including Shuwaikh, Shuaiba and Mina Al Ahmadi (per Wikidata P31 port authority).

name: Kuwait Direct Investment Promotion Authority
description: Kuwait government authority responsible for promoting and licensing foreign direct investment.

name: National Council for Culture, Arts and Literature (Kuwait)
description: Council in Kuwait responsible for culture, arts and literature; operates under the Ministry of Information portfolio.

name: Public Institution for Social Security (Kuwait)
description: Public pension fund of Kuwait.

name: Public Authority for Agricultural Affairs and Fish Resources (Kuwait)
aliases: الهيئة العامة للشؤون الزراعة ومصائد الأسماك
description: Organisation in Kuwait regulating agriculture and fish resources.

name: Kuwait Youth Public Authority
description: Public authority for youth affairs in Kuwait; listed in Wikipedia category of Kuwaiti government bodies.

name: Kuwait Armed Forces
description: Combined military forces of Kuwait, comprising land, air and naval branches.

name: Kuwait Land Forces
description: Land warfare branch of Kuwait's military, established 1949; the oldest branch of the Kuwait Armed Forces.

name: Kuwait Air Force
description: Air warfare branch of Kuwait's armed forces.

name: Kuwait Naval Force
description: Maritime branch of Kuwait's military.

name: Kuwait National Guard
description: Paramilitary and gendarmerie branch of the Kuwait Armed Forces; listed in the State of Kuwait official directory.

name: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation
description: State-owned oil corporation of Kuwait founded 1980; parent of Kuwait Oil Company, Kuwait Gulf Oil Company, Kuwait Petroleum International and Oil Sector Services Company; largest enterprise in Kuwait by revenue (~$121.7B per ZoomInfo 2026).

name: Kuwait Oil Company
description: Kuwaiti oil company founded 1934; upstream oil production subsidiary of Kuwait Petroleum Corporation, based in Al Ahmadi; second-largest Kuwait company by revenue (~$19.8B per ZoomInfo).

name: Kuwait Gulf Oil Company
description: Kuwaiti oil company founded 2002, managing Kuwait's share of partitioned-zone (Divided Zone) resources; subsidiary of Kuwait Petroleum Corporation.

name: Kuwait Petroleum International
description: International downstream arm of Kuwait Petroleum Corporation, founded 1983, operating fuel stations in Europe under the Q8 brand (Arabic label confirms identity; English label absent in Wikidata).

name: Kuwait Airways
description: Flag carrier airline of Kuwait, wholly owned by the government; a 2026 decree converted it into a joint-stock company whose shares stay under direct state ownership (Kuwait Investment Authority).

name: Oil Sector Services Company
description: Kuwaiti oil-sector services company founded 2005 (Arabic label confirms identity; English label absent in Wikidata).

name: Zain Group
description: Kuwaiti multinational telecommunications company founded 1983, operating across the Middle East and Africa.

name: Alshaya Group
description: Kuwaiti brand franchise operator (Starbucks, H&M etc. across MENA); among top Kuwaiti companies by revenue (~$10.5B per ZoomInfo 2026); trading roots from 1890.

name: Alghanim Industries
description: Privately held Kuwaiti conglomerate with operations in retail, automotive, engineering and logistics (owner of X-cite electronics retail).

name: Agility Logistics
description: Kuwaiti logistics company founded 1979, one of the world's largest freight forwarders.

name: Kout Food Group
description: Kuwaiti-based food and restaurant conglomerate founded 1982, franchise operator of international restaurant brands in the region.

name: Mezzan Holding
description: Kuwaiti food, healthcare and consumer conglomerate founded 1944.

name: National Aviation Services
description: Kuwaiti aviation services provider (ground handling, cargo, lounge services) operating across emerging markets.

name: The Kuwaiti Danish Dairy Company
description: Kuwaiti dairy and juice producer (Kuwaiti Danish Dairy Company KCSC).

name: Ooredoo Kuwait
description: Kuwaiti telecommunications company founded 1999 (formerly Wataniya Telecom); subsidiary of Qatar's Ooredoo Group.

name: Fast Telecommunications
description: Kuwaiti internet service provider founded 2001.

name: Sakhr Software Company
description: Kuwaiti software company founded 1982, specializing in Arabic language technologies.

name: Central Bank of Kuwait
description: State-owned central bank of Kuwait; supervises local banks and the 32 exchange companies operating in Kuwait.

name: National Bank of Kuwait
description: Largest and oldest Kuwaiti bank, founded 1952; among the most valuable Kuwaiti companies by market cap (>$26B, 2024).

name: Kuwait Finance House
description: Leading Kuwaiti Islamic bank and the most valuable Kuwaiti listed company by market cap (~$40.9B, Feb 2024); absorbed Ahli United Bank Kuwait in 2024.

name: Gulf Bank of Kuwait
description: One of the largest Kuwaiti conventional banks, listed on Boursa Kuwait.

name: Burgan Bank
description: Kuwaiti bank, part of Kuwait Projects Company (KIPCO) group; operates Burgan Bank Turkey.

name: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait
description: Kuwaiti commercial bank founded 1967.

name: Commercial Bank of Kuwait
description: Kuwaiti commercial bank founded 1960, known as Al-Tijari.

name: Kuwait International Bank
description: Kuwaiti Islamic bank founded 1967.

name: Boubyan Bank
description: Publicly listed Kuwaiti Islamic bank founded 2004; third most valuable Kuwaiti company by market cap in 2024 (~$8.7B).

name: Warba Bank
description: Kuwaiti Islamic bank registered by the Central Bank of Kuwait in 2010; no standalone Wikidata item found.

name: Industrial Bank of Kuwait
description: One of two specialized government-owned banks in Kuwait (with Kuwait Credit Bank), financing industrial projects.

name: Kuwait Credit Bank
description: Specialized government-owned bank in Kuwait providing subsidized loans to citizens (housing etc.); no Wikidata item found.

name: Kuwait Stock Exchange
description: Stock exchange located in Kuwait City, founded 1983; restructured as Boursa Kuwait, one of the first privatized exchanges in the Gulf.

name: Kuwait Financial Centre (Markaz)
description: Kuwaiti investment bank and asset manager founded 1974.

name: Boubyan Takaful Insurance Company
description: Kuwaiti Islamic (takaful) insurance company founded 2006.

name: Kuwait University
description: Public university located in Kuwait City; the country's oldest and largest university (est. 1966).

name: Kuwait Institute for Scientific Research
description: Kuwait's national applied research institute, founded 1967.

name: American University of Kuwait
description: Private liberal-arts university in Kuwait founded 2003.

name: Gulf University for Science and Technology
description: Private university in Kuwait founded 2002, located in Mishref.

name: American University of the Middle East
description: Private university in Kuwait founded 2007.

name: Arab Open University (Kuwait)
description: International university with campuses across the Middle East; Kuwait branch (est. 2000), headquarters of the AOU system in Kuwait.

name: Kuwait Technical College
description: University college in Kuwait (Abu Halifa) founded 2005.

name: Kuwait College of Science and Technology
description: Private science and technology college in Kuwait.

name: Abdullah Al Salem University
description: English-speaking university in Kuwait founded 2019.

name: Public Authority for Applied Education and Training
description: Kuwait's public authority for applied education and vocational training, founded 1982.

name: Mubarak al-Abdullah Joint Command and Staff College
description: Military educational institution in Kuwait City founded 1995, the command and staff college of the Kuwait Armed Forces.

name: Kuwait News Agency
description: Official state news wire service of Kuwait, founded 1956; top Kuwaiti media company by revenue per ZoomInfo.

name: Kuwait Television
description: Kuwait's state television broadcaster, operating multiple channels including KTV 2.

name: Al Rai
description: Kuwaiti Arabic daily newspaper; one of the dominant Arabic dailies in Kuwait. Also the name of a Kuwaiti TV channel (Alrai TV).

name: Al Qabas
description: Arabic daily Kuwaiti newspaper published by Dar Al Qabas Press Printing Publishing and Distribution Company.

name: Kuwait Times
description: English-language daily newspaper in Kuwait; the first English-language paper in the country.

name: Arab Times
description: Leading English-language daily in Kuwait, widely read by expatriates; sister publication of Al-Watan Arabic daily.

name: Al Anba
description: Kuwaiti Arabic daily newspaper; listed among leading Kuwaiti newspapers; no Wikidata item found.

name: Al Jarida
description: Kuwaiti Arabic daily newspaper; listed among leading Kuwaiti news sources; no Wikidata item found.

name: Kuwait Red Crescent Society
description: Humanitarian organization in Kuwait, a national branch of the International Red Crescent movement.

relationships.target_name: International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement

name: Kuwait Foundation for the Advancement of Sciences
description: Nonprofit foundation in Kuwait City founded 1976, funded by Kuwaiti shareholding companies, advancing science and innovation.

name: Kuwait Economic Society
description: Non-governmental organization in Kuwait focused on economic policy debate.

name: Zakat House (Kuwait)
description: Kuwait's official zakat collection and charitable distribution institution, founded 1982.

name: Direct Aid Society
description: Kuwaiti international charitable organization focused on development aid in Africa and Asia; top Kuwaiti organization by revenue in ZoomInfo's NGO list. No Wikidata item found.

name: Kuwait Girl Guides Association
description: National Girl Guides organization of Kuwait, founded 1957; member of WAGGGS.

relationships.target_name: World Association of Girl Guides and Girl Scouts

name: Kuwait Medical Association
description: Professional association of physicians in Kuwait, founded 1963.

name: Kuwait Football Association
description: Governing body of football in Kuwait, founded 1952; organizes the national team and leagues.

name: Olympic Council of Asia
description: Governing body of sports in Asia, headquartered in Kuwait City since 1982; organizes the Asian Games.

name: Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development
description: Kuwait-based pan-Arab development finance institution founded 1968.

name: National Democratic Alliance
description: De facto political party in Kuwait (parties are not legalized), secular/centre-right; led by Bashar Al-Sayegh; founded 1992.

name: Kuwait Democratic Forum
description: Centre-left secular/Arab-nationalist political faction in Kuwait; led by Bandar Al-Khairan.

name: Popular Action Bloc
description: Populist political bloc in Kuwait founded 1992, historically linked to opposition figureheads Musallam Al-Barrak and Ahmed Al-Sadoun.

name: Islamic Constitutional Movement
description: Kuwaiti Sunni Islamist political organization founded 1991 (political arm of the Islamic Culture Society); leader Mohammad al-Olaim.

name: Islamic Salafi Alliance
description: Salafist political bloc in Kuwait; leader Khaled Sultan bin Essa.

name: Justice and Peace Alliance
description: Shia Islamist political bloc in Kuwait founded 2004; leader Saleh Ashour.

name: National Islamic Alliance
description: Shia Islamist political bloc in Kuwait; leader Adnan Zahid Abdulsamad. (Distinct from National Islamic Alliance (Taalof).)

name: Thawabit Al-Umma
description: Salafi-oriented political bloc in Kuwait; leader Bader Al-Dahoum.

name: Kuwaiti Progressive Movement
description: Left-wing political movement in Kuwait (socialist/anti-capitalist); leader Ahmad Aldeyain. No Wikidata item found.

name: Kuwait National Cinema Company
description: Theater chain and film distributor in Kuwait founded 1954, operating the Cinescape brand.
